beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "We paid off the lease early this week. Everything I set out to prove when I quit — it's basically all there now."

options.text: So what happens now that you've actually landed?
Guess you're done taking risks, then.
That's got nothing to do with a card reading.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Honestly? No idea. I never planned past 'don't fail.'"

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: This one's the whole circle closing — but closing isn't the same as stopping.
It means there's nothing left to do now.
This card has nothing to do with finishing anything.

elaboration: A full cycle completed — but the same card that closes it is also the one that clears the way for the next beginning.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Feels weird to go looking for the next thing when this one finally worked."

options.text: That's the actual warning in this card — don't get too comfortable in 'done.'
Then don't — just stop here for good.
The card doesn't warn about anything at all.

elaboration: Don't linger too long in the comfort of 'done' — a new journey is already calling, even right after a real one finishes.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "...Fair. I'll give myself a week to enjoy it. Then back to figuring out what's next."
